# Delco Times

> > Local news, sports, and community information for Delaware County, Pennsylvania and surrounding regions.

Delco Times is a regional news outlet serving Delaware County, PA with coverage of breaking news, crime reports, sports, weather, and community events. The site provides essential local journalism and community information for residents of Delaware County and neighboring areas.

## Key Topics

- Delaware County
- Local News
- Breaking News
- Crime Reports
- Pennsylvania News
- Community News
- Police Investigations
- Sports Coverage
- Chester
- Upper Darby
- Springfield
- Folcroft
- Subscription Services
- Account Management

## News & Information

- [Delco Times – Delco PA News, Sports, Weather and Things to Do](https://www.delcotimes.com): Delco Times homepage with local PA news, sports, weather and community information

## Sports

- [Sports in Delaware County](https://www.delcotimes.com/sports): Delaware County sports news covering high school and Philadelphia professional teams
